mash_thickness.description: Water to grain ratio in quarts per pound (range: 1.0-3.0, typical: 1.25-1.5 qt/lb)

imperial.name: find_styles_for_recipe
imperial.description: Find BJCP beer styles that match a recipe based on calculated values (OG, FG, ABV, IBU, EBC) and ingredient keywords. Returns compatibility scores (0-100) with higher scores indicating better matches. Scoring considers how well recipe parameters fit within BJCP style guidelines.

recipe_id.description: Recipe ID to find matching styles for

keywords.description: Optional keywords to refine style matching (e.g., ['hoppy', 'malty', 'dark'])

limit.description: Maximum number of matching styles to return (default: 10)

imperial.name: get_privacy_policy

style_id.description: Either a UUID (e.g., '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000') or a BJCP style number (e.g., '34A', '21A')

imperial.name: get_terms_of_use

must_mash.description: Search by whether grain requires mashing (true = must mash, false = does not require mashing)

origin.description: Search by origin/country using standardized country names (e.g., "United States" not "US") - case-insensitive partial match

imperial.name: update_fermentation_step_in_recipe
imperial.description: Update a fermentation step in a recipe. Temperature in Fahrenheit.

recipe_fermentation_step_id.description: Unique ID of the fermentation step in the recipe

name.description: Name of the fermentation step (e.g., 'Primary Fermentation', 'Secondary', 'Cold Crash')

temperature_f.description: Temperature in Fahrenheit (range: 59-77°F, typical: 64-68°F for ales, 50-54°F for lagers)

end_temperature_f.description: Ending temperature in Fahrenheit for temperature ramps (range: 59-77°F, null for constant temperature)

duration_days.description: Duration of fermentation step in days

step_order.description: Order of this step in the fermentation process (1, 2, 3, etc.). If order conflicts with existing steps, they will be automatically reordered.

description.description: Optional detailed description of the fermentation step

imperial.name: update_grain_in_recipe
imperial.description: Update a grain's amount in a recipe. To use a different grain variety, use add_grain_to_recipe and remove_grain_from_recipe. Changes affect OG, color, and flavor calculations. Specify weight in pounds.

recipe_grain_id.description: Unique ID of the grain addition in the recipe

imperial.name: update_hop_in_recipe
imperial.description: Update a hop's properties in a recipe (amount, timing, usage). To use a different hop variety, use add_hop_to_recipe and remove_hop_from_recipe. For dry hop additions, use dry_hop_duration_days and dry_hop_start_day instead of time_minutes. Specify weight in ounces and temperature in Fahrenheit.

recipe_hop_id.description: Unique ID of the hop addition in the recipe

alpha_acid_percent_override.description: Override hop alpha acid percentage for this recipe when actual batch analysis differs from database value (0-30%, null to use database value)

use_type.description: When/how hop is used: 'mash' (during mashing), 'first_wort' (added to first wort, uses recipe boil time), 'boil' (during boil), 'whirlpool' (post-boil steeping, optionally specify temperature), 'dry_hop' (during fermentation, optionally specify dry hop timing)

time_minutes.description: Time in minutes (required for boil and whirlpool IBU calculations, optional for mash, not used for first_wort or dry_hop).

temperature_f.description: Temperature in Fahrenheit (required for whirlpool hops 104-212°F, optional for others). When changing use_type to whirlpool, defaults to 176°F if not specified.

dry_hop_duration_days.description: Duration in days for dry hop contact time (optional, null = indefinite/until manual removal)

dry_hop_start_day.description: Days since fermentation start to begin dry hopping (optional, used with dry_hop use_type)

imperial.name: update_mash_step_in_recipe
imperial.description: Update a mash step's properties in a recipe. Changes to step_order will affect the sequence of mash steps. Temperature in Fahrenheit.

recipe_mash_step_id.description: Unique ID of the mash step in the recipe

name.description: Name of the mash step (e.g., 'Protein Rest', 'Saccharification', 'Mash Out')

temperature_f.description: Temperature in Fahrenheit (range: 140-172°F, typical: 149-153°F for saccharification)

duration_minutes.description: Duration of mash step in minutes

step_order.description: Order of this step in the mash process (1, 2, 3, etc.). If order conflicts with existing steps, they will be automatically reordered.

description.description: Optional detailed description of the mash step

imperial.name: update_misc_in_recipe
imperial.description: Update a miscellaneous ingredient's properties in a recipe (amount, timing, usage). To use a different misc ingredient, use add_misc_to_recipe and remove_misc_from_recipe. For fermentation/aging additions, use start_day and duration_days instead of time_minutes.

recipe_misc_id.description: Unique ID of the misc ingredient addition in the recipe

amount_units.description: Amount of ingredient in the specified unit_type (minimum: 0.01)

unit_type.description: Unit type for amount: 'grams' (weight), 'ml' (volume), 'tsp'/'tbsp' (spoons), 'oz' (ounces), 'tablets' (pills), 'drops' (liquid drops), 'pieces' (individual items)

use_type.description: When ingredient is used: 'mash' (during mashing), 'boil' (during boil), 'primary' (primary fermentation), 'secondary' (secondary fermentation), 'bottling' (at bottling, no timing needed), 'aging' (during aging)

time_minutes.description: Time in minutes for mash and boil processes (optional for all use_types). Not used for fermentation stages (use start_day/duration_days) or bottling.

start_day.description: Days from the beginning of the use_type step to add ingredient (optional, used for primary, secondary, aging)

duration_days.description: Duration in days for ingredient contact time (optional, null = indefinite/until manual removal)

imperial.name: update_recipe
imperial.description: Update a recipe's basic information. Batch size in gallons.

recipe_id.description: Recipe ID

name.description: Recipe name

efficiency_percent.description: Mash efficiency percentage (typical range: 70-85%, homebrewer average: 75%)

mash_thickness.description: Water to grain ratio in quarts per pound (range: 1.0-3.0, typical: 1.25-1.5 qt/lb)

brewing_notes.description: Notes about the brewing process, techniques, and observations

tasting_notes.description: Tasting notes, flavor descriptions, and evaluation

bjcp_style_id.description: BJCP style ID or null to clear (use search_beer_styles to find available styles)

imperial.name: update_user_profile
imperial.description: Update the authenticated user's profile data including preferences, equipment profiles, water profiles, ingredient availability, and other AI agent context. IMPORTANT: Proactively suggest profile updates when you learn new information about the user's brewing setup, preferences, or constraints that would improve future recommendations. Always seek explicit permission before updating. Preserve existing content and update to reflect current state only - do not add edit annotations or change logs. Markdown formatting is supported and should be preserved. You may provide a markdown link to [view profile](/profile) if the user needs to see their current profile information.

profile.description: User profile data in markdown format (equipment, preferences, water profiles, ingredient availability, brewing setup, etc.)

imperial.name: update_water_in_recipe
imperial.description: Update water properties in a recipe. Changes to base water profile will recalculate brewing salt additions automatically. Volume in gallons.

recipe_water_id.description: Unique ID of the water addition in the recipe

name.description: Descriptive name for water addition (e.g., 'Mash Water', 'Sparge Water')

ca_ppm.description: Target calcium content in parts per million (ppm)

mg_ppm.description: Target magnesium content in parts per million (ppm)

na_ppm.description: Target sodium content in parts per million (ppm)

so4_ppm.description: Target sulfate content in parts per million (ppm)

cl_ppm.description: Target chloride content in parts per million (ppm)

hco3_ppm.description: Target bicarbonate content in parts per million (ppm)

base_ca_ppm.description: Base water calcium content in ppm - your starting water chemistry before salt additions (leave null if unknown). Used to calculate which brewing salts to add to reach target values.

base_mg_ppm.description: Base water magnesium content in ppm - your starting water chemistry before salt additions (leave null if unknown). Used to calculate which brewing salts to add to reach target values.

base_na_ppm.description: Base water sodium content in ppm - your starting water chemistry before salt additions (leave null if unknown). Used to calculate which brewing salts to add to reach target values.

base_so4_ppm.description: Base water sulfate content in ppm - your starting water chemistry before salt additions (leave null if unknown). Used to calculate which brewing salts to add to reach target values.

base_cl_ppm.description: Base water chloride content in ppm - your starting water chemistry before salt additions (leave null if unknown). Used to calculate which brewing salts to add to reach target values.

base_hco3_ppm.description: Base water bicarbonate content in ppm - your starting water chemistry before salt additions (leave null if unknown). Used to calculate which brewing salts to add to reach target values.

imperial.name: update_yeast_in_recipe
imperial.description: Update a yeast's properties in a recipe (amount, unit type). To use a different yeast strain, use add_yeast_to_recipe and remove_yeast_from_recipe. Changes affect attenuation calculations.

recipe_yeast_id.description: Unique ID of the yeast addition in the recipe

amount_units.description: Amount of yeast in the specified unit_type

unit_type.description: Unit type for yeast amount: 'packets' (dry yeast packets), 'grams' (dry yeast by weight), 'ml' (liquid yeast volume)
